findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: youtube_transcript, youtube_channel, youtube_video, youtube_comments, youtube_playlist · Private data: youtube_video, youtube_playlist · Public sink: youtube_search, youtube_channel, youtube_video, youtube_comments, youtube_search_trial.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: youtube_transcript, youtube_channel, youtube_video, youtube_comments, youtube_playlist · Private data: youtube_video, youtube_playlist · Public sink: youtube_search, youtube_channel, youtube_video, youtube_comments, youtube_search_trial

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
